title: Topic 2.3: King Solomon the wise ruler

pages.lesson:
LESSON: KING SOLOMON THE WISE RULER

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Bible
Topic 2.3: King Solomon the wise ruler

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on King Solomon the wise ruler. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How did Solomon demonstrate wisdom in his judgement?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. apply lessons learnt from the story of King Solomon in daily life

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: KING SOLOMON THE WISE RULER
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: Grade 5
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
King Solomon the wise ruler helps you succeed in CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: KING SOLOMON THE WISE RULER
Study King Solomon the wise ruler like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Apply lessons learnt from the story of King Solomon in daily life

What this means
In this part you learn to apply lessons learnt from the story of King Solomon in daily life. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: apply lessons learnt from the story of King Solomon in daily life.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “King Solomon the wise ruler” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can apply lessons learnt from the story of King Solomon in daily life. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what King Solomon the wise ruler is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “King Solomon the wise ruler” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: apply lessons learnt from the story of King Solomon in daily life)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach King Solomon the wise ruler to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: apply lessons learnt from the story of King Solomon in daily life.
3. Make one local Kenya example of King Solomon the wise ruler from your county, market, farm, or school.
4. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for King Solomon the wise ruler: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 5 learner study King Solomon the wise ruler?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How did Solomon demonstrate wisdom in his judgement?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what King Solomon the wise ruler means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: apply lessons learnt from the story of King Solomon in daily life.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
